text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to attend a seminar held by an
instructor
from a prestigious
Umamusume training school. In
front of
the venue, I meet...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now here's a familiar face. Have you
come to
listen to my mother's talk as
well? Your
dedication is laudable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You came without knowing that?
Absurd. My
mother has trained many
superb Umamusume.
Know that every
word she utters is replete with
wisdom!
choice_data_list: え、今日の講師って、君のお母さん！？
え、今日の講師って、貴方のお母さん！？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, today's instructor is your mother!?
Wait, today's instructor is your mother!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now, during this exercise, it's important
for the
trainee to position themself like
bam and
squeeze, then bring that
oomph down low.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you should activate your
abdominal
muscles while keeping your
back straight, then
shift the load into
your glutes.
choice_data_list: （ど、どうしよう、全然わからない……）
choice_data_list_en: (Wh-what do I do? I have no idea...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just paying attention to those things is
sure to
drastically improve the quality of
training
exercises. That's my mother for
you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
When instructing children, you must
grasp the
idiosyncrasies of how each of
them run—oh,
please hold on! My nose
is itching. Ahh... Ahh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: AAACHOOO!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Simply magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's so bold, sneezing at full force with
no
reservations about what others may
think! What
tenacious mental fortitude!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is no doubt the secret behind my
mother's
success in the grand races she
ran. I must learn
from her example!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's watch footage from a famous
race
during your career so we can look
back on that
time—
choice_data_list: （リスペクト具合が妙な方向に……）
choice_data_list_en: (Her admiration has taken a strange turn...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please wait a moment! Watching old
footage
is all well and good, but what
do you say we
reenact that race, right
here and now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It would be far more beneficial to
witness the race
with your own eyes!
Let's see... Air Groove! Could
you play
the role of my rival, please? ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Y-you want me to stand in for your
rival?! But I
haven't rehearsed or
prepared anything...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine! You've watched that
Japanese
Oaks video countless times
since you were a
child! Quickly, come up
on stage!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: O-of course...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They even prepare a racecourse
backdrop for the
stage, and the
reenactment co-starring the

mother-daughter pair is brought to life.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: And now it becomes a fierce competition on the straight! Okay! Here my rival, number nine, appears from the outside! Come in like vwooosh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: V-v-vwooosh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That cute expression won't cut it! You
need to
glare at me with rage!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Y-you want me to glare at you, Mother?!
Grrr...
H-how is this?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: No, that's all wrong! Sharpen your gaze and really scowl! Start again from the vwooosh part!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Um, f-from the vwooosh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They have to redo parts of the race
multiple
times, but the seminar hosted
by Air Groove's
mother is eventually
brought to a close.
choice_data_list: （エアグルーヴ、大変そうだな……）
choice_data_list_en: (Air Groove's got her hands full, huh...)
(Air Groove looks like she's having a tough time...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
M-Mother... I can't believe you dragged
me on
stage without discussing anything
in advance. I
almost...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's no surprise Air Groove feels so upset.
Her
mother definitely went too fa—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I almost couldn't contain the
admiration within
me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't have asked for a better place
to train
my mental strength! Thank you
for bestowing me
such a valuable
learning opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must review today's events and really
commit
the knowledge I gleaned into my
head! If you'll
excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, she's far too serious about
these
things. But I guess that's just like
her...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
But with how air-headed I am, I suppose
it's only
natural that my daughter would
compensate by
being extra on top of
things.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Well, no point dwelling on it. Maybe I
should
take her out somewhere as an
apology.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I learned a great deal about the

unconventional relationship between Air
Groove
and her mother.
